title: Which Rail is Which?
story: In PLC ladder logic, outputs always connect to the right neutral/return rail (R). If an output is connected directly to the left rail (L), it can cause a short circuit or fail standard PLC safety rules.
concept: Outputs (coils, lamps, motors) must always return to Rail R on the right side of the diagram.

learn.title: Rail Convention
learn.text: Rule: Input contacts go on the left, output loads go on the right! Connecting a lamp directly to L and button to R violates standard ladder structure.

hints: Place the switch near Rail L and the lamp near Rail R.
Wire Rail L to START, START to LAMP, and LAMP to Rail R.
Never connect a coil or lamp to Rail L.
